name: Raid on the Kolkar
summary: In Desolace, Uthek the Wise sends you northeast against the Kolkar centaurs. After Strange Alliance, he wants ten of their charms brought back.

sections.title: Contempt for Kolkar Magic
sections.body: Uthek scorns the Kolkar centaurs for trusting in their magic. To him, they know nothing of such things. So you head northeast, kill Kolkar, and take their charms. Uthek wants ten Crude Charms to cast into the fire and laugh as they burn.

sections.title: Uthek's Verdict
sections.body: Uthek calls your deed good for the Gelkis. He says the Kolkar are feeble and doomed, and their magic cannot save them. They have seen your work and will fear the Gelkis all the more. Fear weakens them, and in Gelkis lands, the feeble soon die.

aliases: who gives raid on the kolkar
faq.answer: Uthek the Wise waits in Gelkis Village in Desolace and wants the Kolkar's charms.
Uthek says the Kolkar are northeast.
Crude Charms are taken from the Kolkar. Uthek wants ten cast into the fire so he can laugh as they burn.

faq.q: How does this fit into the Gelkis chain?
aliases: what comes before raid on the kolkar
faq.answer: Raid on the Kolkar follows Strange Alliance.
